title: Medical-Burden Points in Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Hardship Assistance
content:
**Assistance committee criteria.** On an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account with a hardship approval in force, medical-burden points are added to the hardship assistance percentage by a measure that depends on the patient's equipment.

| Patient's situation | Medical-burden points |
|---|---|
| The patient's wheelchair record (Mobility Equipment) is rental active | one point for each full 300.00 of patient charges on this coverage account whose whole calendar months before the handling date do not exceed those of that wheelchair's rental period start date |
| No rental-active wheelchair, and the coverage class counts its benefit year as a plan year (Commercial HMO, Commercial PPO) | one point for each full 300.00 of patient charges on this coverage account whose whole calendar months before the handling date do not exceed those of the coverage record's benefit-year start |
| Any other patient | no medical-burden points |

The points are percentage points added to the account's assistance percentage itself; they are never applied as a separate discount after it. Only full steps of 300.00 count: the total of the charges counted is divided by 300.00 and any remainder is dropped.

## Which charges count (hypothetical dates; handling date 15 September)

| Patient | Anchor | Whole months from anchor to handling date | Charge posted 10 April (5 whole months before) | Charge posted 10 March (6 whole months before) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wheelchair rental active, rental period start 20 March | 20 March | 5 | counts | does not count |
| No active wheelchair, Commercial PPO, benefit-year start 1 July | 1 July | 2 | does not count | does not count |
| No active wheelchair, Original Medicare Part B | — | — | no points at all | no points at all |

## Steps of 300.00 (hypothetical totals of charges counted)

| Total | Points |
|---|---|
| 299.99 | 0 |
| 300.00 | 1 |
| 899.99 | 2 |
| 1500.00 | 5 |
